feature_projection_overlap: Preserve all rows and assigned splits. For model selection exclude validation feature vectors seen in training. Report full test scores plus a fixed sensitivity subset excluding feature vectors seen in train or validation. Masks use planning inputs only, no labels.
test_policy: Evaluate selected classifier plus the prior baseline once per target; no test-driven selection, tuning or threshold adjustment.
training_sample_weight: Each connected split group has equal total weight, normalized to mean row weight one; target-independent.
transformations: None: fixed archived one-hot encodings and finite planning predictors only. No fitted scaling, imputation, resampling, target balancing or feature selection.
limitations: Uncalibrated model scores, random realization noise, one shared hypothetical template scope; no unseen-template or real-world accuracy claim.
